page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-192GB-2xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring dedicated graphics acceleration and substantial system memory. Running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 CPU architecture, this configuration features 16 shared vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.0 GB per vCPU.

The server is equipped with two NVIDIA L4 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace architecture family, providing a combined total of 48 GB of VRAM. This hardware profile does not include local storage, meaning storage resources must be attached externally. Additionally, the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Given the shared CPU allocation combined with high-capacity system memory and dual NVIDIA L4 GPUs, this server offers a specialized resource density for memory-intensive GPU tasks. It is configured for workloads such as machine learning inference, data science pipelines, video transcoding, and analytical processing where GPU acceleration and large memory footprints are required, but dedicated CPU cores are not the primary bottleneck.
